page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance based on KVM virtualization. The configuration supplies 24 dedicated vCPUs running on an Intel Xeon 8475B processor with an x86_64 architecture and a nominal clock speed of 2.7 GHz. System memory totals 96.0 GB, which aligns with the standard enterprise 1:4 compute-to-memory proportion of 4.0 GB per allocated virtual processor.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring external cloud block storage for operating system images and persistent data. Graphical acceleration is absent, with zero GPUs provisioned. Connectivity features a 15 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and the server includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating private addressing or attached virtual network interfaces for external reachability.

Because the server avoids the overhead of specialized hardware accelerators and relies entirely on external storage volumes, resource efficiency centers on predictable multi-threaded CPU and memory density. The balance of 24 dedicated cores and 96.0 GB of memory makes the ecs.g8i.6xlarge appropriate for containerized worker nodes, enterprise resource planning platforms, mid-tier relational databases, continuous integration environments, and backend web serving.
